---
name: Claim a feature
about: Take a Ready feature from ROADMAP.md
title: "Claim EH-XXX: "
---

**Feature** — the ID and name from [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/arupmmi07/ethan/blob/main/ROADMAP.md), e.g. `EH-023 — Answer
"status" asks from the ledger`.

**Plan** — two or three sentences: what you will change, and the test you will add.

**First pull request** — when you expect to open it. The claim returns to `Ready` if
nothing visible happens for 21 days; say so here if you need longer.
